name: CocoaPods CDN
auth: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.
fresh_home: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.
prerequisites: Use a disposable client container with /work as its home and project directory.
A source archive containing a supported podspec with matching name/version and source files.
Python 3 is required by the configuration snippet to encode runtime credentials safely.

configure.code:
export COCOAPODS_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
export COCOAPODS_DISABLE_STATS=true
python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import os
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
with open(".netrc", "w") as f:
    f.write("machine %s login %s password %s\n" % (urlsplit(os.environ["AW_URL"]).hostname, os.environ["AW_USER"], os.environ["AW_TOKEN"]))
os.chmod(".netrc", 0o600)
PYCODE
configure.note: Create .netrc in the disposable container home; AW_USER/AW_TOKEN must not contain whitespace.

configure.code:
source ENV.fetch('AW_URL') + '/artifactory/api/pods/' + ENV.fetch('AW_REPO')
install! 'cocoapods', :integrate_targets => false
platform :ios, '12.0'
target 'Demo' do
  pod 'HelloPod', '1.0.0'
end
configure.note: Podfile for the dependency-only recipe. For a real Xcode project, use its normal target integration settings.

publish.note: Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

install.note: Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

steps.code:
pod repo add-cdn weave "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/pods/$AW_REPO"
pod install --no-repo-update
steps.note: Start without Pods, Podfile.lock or previous CocoaPods caches; in a root-only test container the harness uses --allow-root.

limitations: CocoaPods upstream Git archives and recursive submodules must satisfy the configured server source policy.
Do not enable arbitrary Ruby podspec execution on the server; supported static podspec parsing is documented by the adapter.

contains: A Basic user name must name the token's subject
